name: ITO Etchant (HCl + HNO3)
description: ITO Etchant (HCl + HNO3) is a mineral acid-based wet etching solution combining hydrochloric acid and nitric acid for high-performance Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) patterning. This aqua regia-type formulation provides aggressive and uniform ITO etching with clean surface finish, making it ideal for advanced FPD and LED transparent electrode fabrication. The synergistic combination of oxidizing (HNO3) and complexing (HCl) acids ensures complete dissolution of both indium and tin components without residue formation. This formulation is preferred for high-throughput production where fast etch rates and minimal undercut are required.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear to pale yellow fuming liquid; Density: ~1.2-1.4 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: >100 °C
